new_ops.name: disentangled_attention
new_ops.reason: Attention logits are the sum of content-to-content Q_c K_c^T, content-to-position Q_c[i] K_r[delta(i,j)]^T and position-to-content K_c[j] Q_r[delta(j,i)]^T, where K_r = P W_{k,r}, Q_r = P W_{q,r}, P in R^{2k x d} is a relative position table shared across layers and delta(i,j) clips i-j+k to [0,2k); then softmax(A/sqrt(3d)) V_c. Needs a primitive for per-pair gathering of relative-position projections into the attention logits (shape [heads, T, T] from [T,d] and [2k,d]).

new_ops.name: enhanced_mask_decoder
new_ops.reason: A stack of n=2 weight-shared Transformer-style layers taking two inputs (I, H): the query stream I starts as absolute position embeddings (added to content hidden state) and attends over H; output of each layer becomes I of the next and the last feeds the LM head. Needs a cross-stream attention layer with separate query and key/value inputs plus an absolute position table, applied only in the decoding head.
new_ops.quote: In our experiment we share the same weight for $n=2$ layers to reduce the number of parameters and use absolute position embedding as $I$ of the first EMD layer.
new_ops.where: Sec. Additional Details of Enhanced Mask Decoder

output.notes: Described the core DeBERTa (base/large) architecture with disentangled attention and EMD; 1.5B-specific changes (shared projections, conv layer, 128K vocab) listed as mechanisms. Base/large use the RoBERTa/GPT-2 BPE vocabulary but the size is not given. The 1.5B model's vocabulary is described only as '128K', so vocab_size is left not_stated rather than guessing an exact count. Norm, placement, activation and residual are inherited from BERT via the explicit 'follows that of the BERT base model' sentence. Eps, biases, tying and context length are not stated. Configs are listed in the pre-training table's order (1.5B, large, base); the base-ablation column is a training setting, not a separate architecture.
